Knowledge Vault Desktop — internal test build (M1).

Creates an Obsidian-compatible personal knowledge vault from the bundled offline template (`obsidian-knowledge-system` @ `a3320825e59e`).

**Downloads**
- Windows: `Knowledge Vault Setup <version>.exe` (installer) or the portable `.exe`.
- macOS: `.dmg` (`arm64` for Apple Silicon, `x64` for Intel).

**These builds are unsigned.**
- macOS: on first launch, right-click (or Control-click) the app and choose **Open**, then confirm **Open** in the dialog. Double-clicking will be blocked by Gatekeeper the first time.
- Windows: SmartScreen may warn; choose **More info → Run anyway**.

Not included in M1: Agent chat, DeepSeek Harness integration, full note editor.
